title: E21 Program: Single-AZ True Sharding and Replication
description: Primary roadmap to align runtime behavior with agreed NotDynamo design: per-shard consensus, shard-aware routing, failure correctness, and benchmarkable scale behavior in single-AZ Kubernetes/EKS.
acceptance_criteria: All child E22-E33 tasks are closed with verification artifacts and benchmark reports.
notes: [2026-02-18 07:01:30Z] Initialized Beads roadmap and checkpoint workflow

title: E22 Shard Metadata v2 (per-shard group + replica set)
description: Define shard-level metadata schema: shard id, replica members, leader hint, epoch/version, ownership history, and rebalance state. Persist and expose through control-plane endpoint consumed by nodes.
acceptance_criteria: Nodes consume metadata v2 and route by shard descriptor; metadata versioning tested under update.
notes:
[2026-02-18 07:06:02Z] Start E22: shard metadata v2 schema and control-plane endpoint consumption
[2026-02-18 07:13:27Z] Implemented shard metadata v2 schema, control-plane JSON endpoint, node control-plane map fetch, and validation tests
[2026-02-18 07:13:35Z] Acceptance met: nodes consume v2 partition metadata from control-plane and version update tests pass

title: E31 Single-AZ horizontal scaling sweeps
description: Run controlled scaling sweeps (node count and pod count) to characterize throughput/latency/error trends and identify near-term bottlenecks.
acceptance_criteria: Sweep automation produces per-run reports and a summary matrix for scaling behavior.

title: E32 EKS benchmark runbook (budget-safe setup/teardown)
description: Harden one-command EKS lifecycle for benchmark runs with budget guardrails, deterministic teardown, and dangling-resource checks.
acceptance_criteria: Setup->deploy->bench->teardown path completes and cleanup report confirms no dangling billable resources.

title: E33 Multi-AZ resilience phase (deferred)
description: Post single-AZ completion: multi-AZ placement policies, AZ-failure drills, and benchmark deltas under AZ loss.
acceptance_criteria: Multi-AZ plan approved and baseline AZ-failure drills scripted.

title: E23 Multi-Raft runtime (one Raft group per shard)
description: Integrate Apache Ratis runtime so each shard is backed by its own Raft group (not one global group). Support shard group bootstrap, restart, and local persistence.
acceptance_criteria: At least 2 distinct shards have independent leaders and replication logs validated in tests.
notes:

[2026-02-18 07:20:38Z] Implemented multi-shard Ratis engine (per-shard groups), wired NodeMain RAFT path to shard descriptors, and added independent leader/log validation test
[2026-02-18 07:20:43Z] Acceptance met: per-shard Raft groups with independent leader/log behavior validated in RatisMultiShardConsensusEngineIT

title: E24 True shard-aware write path (leader-targeted quorum)
description: Route PUT/DELETE to the leader of the target shard Raft group. Enforce quorum ack policy (rf=3, majority) at shard scope and preserve durability semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Writes for multiple shards are accepted by their respective shard leaders; per-shard quorum behavior verified.
notes:

[2026-02-18 07:23:44Z] Acceptance met: writes for different shards route to designated leaders with quorum-backed Raft commit path

title: E25 Eventual read path with staleness contract
description: Serve reads from any replica using replica freshness metadata and bounded-staleness policy. Add controls for strong/leader reads vs eventual replica reads.
acceptance_criteria: Eventual reads pass correctness tests with stale-read target under 1s in steady state.
notes:

[2026-02-18 07:28:14Z] Acceptance met: eventual reads honor freshness budget with leader fallback, and strong leader-read mode is configurable

title: E26 Rebalance planner for shard movement
description: Enhance planner to compute shard reassignment across nodes under scale up/down with minimal movement and RF constraints.
acceptance_criteria: Planner emits valid movement plans for add/remove node scenarios; invariants tested.

title: E27 Rebalance executor (stream/catchup/switch)
description: Implement online shard move execution: copy state, catch up via Raft/log replication, atomic cutover, and old replica retirement.
acceptance_criteria: Shard move completes without data loss and with bounded error window in integration tests.
